about: North Dundas is a township in Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry, Ontario, inland from the St. Lawrence between Ottawa and Cornwall—not a city. Winchester, Chesterville, and Morewood sit among dairy farms and rural roads in eastern Ontario’s historic Dundas County. About 11,000 people live in North Dundas.
